reason: My parents and a relative in India already handle bank paperwork for me for free, and I would rather deal with a CA I know than a new company online. It might make sense if I ever had a big lump sum, but for my usual rental and pension money I would not pay.
objection: My relative in India can sort this out for free, and I do not know this company or its CA. If the tax filing or T1135 reporting goes wrong, I am the one in trouble.
would_change_my_mind: Hearing from my own CA in Canada or India that they have worked with this company, plus a verifiable FINTRAC registration and a clear written statement of what TDS I would owe, with the fee only charged once the money arrives.
